title: Federcalcio, Gravina re -elected with 98.68%. Infantino: "For the World Cup, give yourself a move" - ​​Football
text:
ROMA – A plebiscite, almost a Bulgarian election. Gabriele Gravina He remains president of the Football Federation and the outcome could no longer be taken for granted. Also in numbers: to support it, 98.68% of the votes. After months, indeed years of internal tensions, the movement of Italian football has consolidated around the name of the president in office since 2018. Under the eyes of the president of Fifa Gianni Infantino and the UEFA number one Alexander Cefer the most evident absence was that of Gravina’s great enemy: Claudio Lotito .
Gravina re -elected with 98.68% of the votes Gravina therefore remains president with a very wide consensus, and to close the ceremony of her proclamation she chose to mention the American president Gerald Ford: “Putting himself together is a beginning, staying together is progress, working together”. The objectives of his third term summarized them in a 20 -minute speech with which he opened the assembly, in which he mentioned Pope Francis and claimed the results of his management: “We kept Italian football in the life in the pandemic tunnel, Challenging pessimism and moralism, affirming the right to be happy. By rescuing the economy of the system “and” we have adapted the governance of football well beyond the forecasts of the legislator and the requests of the movement, substantially accentuating the autonomy of the individual alloys “. Closing with the usual attack on enemies: “The unit has allowed us to counter the direct and indirect attacks and to unmask lies, trains and slanders whose public life of our country is sometimes made”. He obviously thought of the investigation that for almost a year has been hanging over his head and that he should soon end with the indictment for self -laundering for a purchase and sale of ancient books. But there was no effect on his re -election.
Infantino leaves the room before proclamation Not a coincidence, but perhaps a signal. Gianni Infantino, president of Fifa, left the room immediately after the vote, without waiting for the proclamation. Leaving the Hotel Rome Cavalieri, then, he gave a wand to Italy (“I am president Fifa from two World Cup and Italy never participated. Give you a move …”) and then scratched UEFA – despite the ‘Start he had chatted with the president Ceferin on the bar’s sofas – and national championships: “The Club World Cup is a beautiful competition that replaces the old confederation cup that made little sense. Fifa eventually organizes 1% of the games, maybe we look at those who are responsible for the other 99 before removing that one percent “.
